summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing complete. All 15 pytest cases pass (auth, notes text+PDF via Gemini, MCQ generate, mixed, session, answer w/ idempotency, history+filters, chapters, progress, delete cascade). UI flow (register -> notes upload -> generate MCQs -> practice with correct/incorrect feedback -> history filters -> progress -> mixed session) drives real Gemini calls end-to-end. Progress math validated: answered=2 correct=1 incorrect=1 accuracy=50% matches actual answers. PDF extraction via Gemini (previously broken NameError) is FIXED and returns keyword-verified text.
ai_feature_verdicts: PDF/image OCR extraction (Gemini gemini-2.5-flash) - pass - evidence: POST /api/notes/upload with reportlab-generated 'photosynthesis.pdf' returned source_type=pdf, content_length>40, preview contained 'photosynthesis'/'chlorophyll'/'calvin' - test: tests/backend_test.py::TestFullFlow::test_pdf_note_extracted_via_gemini

MCQ generation from single note (Gemini) - pass - evidence: POST /api/mcqs/generate {count:3} returned 3 MCQs with valid A/B/C/D options, correct_option in {A,B,C,D}, real explanation strings, single shared session_id; UI Q1 rendered 'What are considered the basic units of life?' with correct=C=Cells (grounded in provided notes)
MCQ generation mixed across chapters (Gemini) - pass - evidence: POST /api/mcqs/generate-mixed with 2 note_ids returned MCQs whose chapters were in {Cell Biology, Photosynthesis}

issues: Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on the accuracy-by-chapter bar chart. Bar still renders after resize, but the initial hidden-container warning suggests the ResponsiveContainer parent has no explicit height at first paint. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: JWT_SECRET default 'dev-secret' fallback in code; .env sets a value so this is safe now, but consider failing hard if unset in production.

server.py POST /notes/upload: allowed set includes .txt/.md but source_type mapping only assigns 'text' or 'image' or 'pdf' -- txt/md correctly resolved to 'text'. Note that plain text is loaded directly (skips Gemini) - good.
server.py answer_mcq idempotency check uses `mcq.get('selected_option')` truthy; since selected_option is one of 'A/B/C/D' (all truthy), works correctly. Verified via test.
llm_service.py generate_mcqs: content is truncated at 20000 chars per chapter which is reasonable; consider surfacing that in logs when truncation happens.
Progress chart in Progress.jsx: ResponsiveContainer without explicit parent height triggers Recharts width(-1) warning on first paint. Minor UI polish item.
test_credentials: Uses fresh random tester+<uuid>@example.com / Test1234! per run via /api/auth/register. Matches /app/memory/test_credentials.md guidance.
seed_data_creation: Each backend run registers a fresh flow user and uploads a Cell Biology text note + an in-memory reportlab-generated Photosynthesis PDF; MCQs and progress are created against that user. UI run registers a separate fresh user and uploads a Cell Biology UI text note + generates 5 chapter MCQs and 5 mixed MCQs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini forces xdist loadscope; do NOT split cross-dependent tests across classes. All flow tests are in TestFullFlow with class-scoped fixtures. To rerun: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview_url> pytest tests/backend_test.py -v. PDF fixture uses reportlab (installed at pip). Gemini via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY works; MCQ generation takes ~10-20s per call, tests use 180s timeouts. Bug from prior iteration (llm_service._api_key vs EMERGENT_LLM_KEY NameError) is confirmed fixed.
rca of the issue: N/A - prior HIGH bug (NameError in extract_text_from_file) is verified fixed by end-to-end PDF upload -> Gemini extraction -> keyword-verified content.
